record: osc_subth release probe: released klayout-tools 0.9.1 vs 0.9.2 LVS on both input streams, plus the one-corner ring-start on the 0.9.2 extraction (issue #275; the 2AMLogic/klayout-tools#5311 reporter verification)
label: SIMULATED (klt extract/lvs structural runs and one local single `ngspice -b` probe, no grid); nothing measured

tools.klt_0.9.2: klt 0.9.2, git 046ba74652fc096bd97071fc3237f7159dd40183, klt_reinstall_spec klayout-tools==0.9.2 (contains the #5311 fix #5315, 593dd38d1, per the GitHub compare cited in issue #275)
tools.invocation: uvx --from klayout-tools==<version> klt ... (no host tool touched; the CI pin in .github/workflows/signoff.yml stays klayout-tools==0.9.1)

procedure: per stream, in a fresh scratch directory: the stream's own layout/osc_bank.gds, lvs/osc_subth.request.json and lvs/osc_subth.ref.spice (all three from the same commit); `klt extract osc_bank.gds --deck sky130 --top osc_subth --pins en,out,vdd,vss -o osc_subth.layout.spice` (the plain-element form klt lvs requires, matching the committed lvs/osc_subth.layout.spice header); then `klt lvs osc_subth.request.json --format json` against that freshly extracted netlist

pre_divider_original_reporter_inputs.source_commit: 8edb3f4 (parent of 25c89ad, the commit that added the divider)
pre_divider_original_reporter_inputs.historical_dev661: the upstream filing reports 48 layout nets vs 34 reference nets on klt 0.9.2.dev661+g1de5c0432aad for this input set (observation published in 2AMLogic/klayout-tools#5311; HISTORICAL, not re-run here). Neither release reproduces it: the 14 stepped-width shared source/drain junctions are one net again on 0.9.2.

divider_bearing.source_commit: b9fc650 (main at the time of this record)
divider_bearing.mismatch_note: the 2 mismatches are the known res_high_po caveats of the committed lvs/osc_subth.report.json (klt lvs does not compare drawn-resistor L/W; R is a placeholder on the reference side), identical on both releases

vh_split_check_klt_0.9.2.script: sim/pex/diag/vh_split.py run with the 0.9.2 environment's own Python (klayout.db 0.30.13) and klt 0.9.2 first on PATH; divider-bearing GDS

header_device_klt_0.9.2.lvs_plain_element_form: pfet L=0.5U W=0.42U AS=0.2205P AD=0.1218P PS=1.54U — all 14 headers identical, and byte-identical parameter values on klt 0.9.1 (the apportioned shared-diffusion geometry of the #5315 fix)
header_device_klt_0.9.2.pex_subckt_call_form: sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt L=0.5 W=0.42 (X card; this form carries no AS/AD)
header_device_klt_0.9.2.pex_device_counts_note: the schematic's 16/16/14 plus the two drawn Rb0/Rb1 divider resistors, as on dev661-after-#5304 and dev2493

ring_start_probe_klt_0.9.2.testbench: sim/pex/probe/osc_subth_vbp_probe.cir via sim/pex/probe/run_probe.sh; en ramps 0->1.8 V at 1 ns; .tran 20n 100u; rising edges counted at 0.9 V; vbp free (no force)
ring_start_probe_klt_0.9.2.model_lib: open_pdks c6d73a35f524070e85faff4a6a9eef49553ebc2b sky130A libs.tech/ngspice/sky130.lib.spice, section tt (the repo's sim/pdk.json pin)
ring_start_probe_klt_0.9.2.extraction: klt pex layout/osc_bank.gds --deck sky130 --pdk sky130A --pdk-root <repo-pinned sky130A> --top osc_subth --pins en,out,vdd,vss --extract-only; status not_checked (exit 4, the documented --extract-only code), extraction devices=48 nets=34

extracted_netlist.note: byte-identical to the committed sim/pex/extracted/osc_subth.dev2493.spice (records/2026-11-20-osc_subth-probe-dev2493.json), so the released 0.9.2 and the dev2493 first-fix build extract the same bytes here

upstream: reporter result posted on 2AMLogic/klayout-tools#5311 (match on the original inputs on 0.9.2, with the 0.9.1 control counts): https://github.com/2AMLogic/klayout-tools/issues/5311#issuecomment-7050857025 — closure stays with the upstream owner
not_done: no pin migration: .github/workflows/signoff.yml keeps klayout-tools==0.9.1; moving the pin re-renders the signoff record and attestations and is its own change
no layout, extracted-netlist, request or reference edit; no spec threshold touched
conclusion: Released klayout-tools 0.9.2 reproduces the original osc_subth LVS match on both input streams (0.9.1 control: match on both too), the dev661 48-vs-34 net split does not reproduce, the 14 vh headers are single nets (14/14, control 14/14), and the one-corner extracted ring-start is 111 rising edges / 100 us at tt/1.80 V/27 C — identical to the dev2493 first-fix build and against 169 schematic / 0 on the split dev661 extraction. The 2AMLogic/klayout-tools#5311 out-of-band acceptance criterion is met from the reporter side.
